module: Manages the time of day of a rally loop. Builds the player setting "Loop Time" (Default, Now, then each HH:MM time listed in loopTimes), translates the choice into environment parameters for missionManager, and drives the sky via core_environment (play, time, date). Only touches the time-related fields; the mission's weather is preserved.
notes: Special values: defaultValue = '__rallyLoopTimeDefault' (static time, noon, clock stopped), nowValue = '__rallyLoopTimeNow' (completely disables the environment module, everything stays as in freeroam).
The raw tod.time is shifted by half a day relative to the wall clock: noon is 0. parseTime computes (fraction of the day - 0.5) % 1.
The CSV times use timeScale = 7/36 (day of about 9257 s with a base of 1800 s); the Default option uses timeScale = 0.
To stop/advance the clock, only send the fields to change to setTimeOfDay: a full table from getTimeOfDay (startTime, date) does not stop the clock (code comment).
applyToEnvironment fills cloudCover, cloudWindSpeed, fogDensity with the current weather when they are nil, and windSpeed/windDirAngle with 0.

parseTimes.desc: Parses a comma-separated list of "HH:MM" times; invalid entries (format, hour > 23, minute > 59) are ignored.

returns.desc: List of {clock = 'HH:MM', time = raw tod.time value in [0,1)}; empty if str is not a string.

buildMissionSetting.desc: Builds the 'select'-type setting "Loop Time": options Default, Now, then one option per time of missionTypeData.loopTimes (the value is the clock string to avoid float drift).

returns.desc: Setting table {key, label, type, values, value, defaultValue, currentOption}.

applyToEnvironment.desc: Applies the choice to the mission's environment table (environment setup module). Now: enabled=false. Default: time=0, timeScale=0, _rallyForceStatic=true. CSV time: parsed time, timeScale=7/36. Fills in missing weather.

environment.desc: Environment table modified in place (ignored if not a table).

selectedValue.desc: Chosen value: nowValue, defaultValue, nil (= default) or 'HH:MM' string.

setPlaying.desc: Forces the play state of the time-of-day clock via core_environment.setTimeOfDay, optionally with a time to restore.

play.desc: true to make time advance, false to freeze it.

time.desc: Raw tod.time value to apply at the same time.

returns.desc: false if core_environment is unavailable, otherwise true.

applyCurrentDate.desc: Applies the real current date (year, month, day) to the sky (positions of the sun, moon, stars) without changing the time.

returns.desc: false if core_environment is unavailable, otherwise true.

advancePlayingTime.desc: Advances the time of day by seconds game seconds: time = (time + seconds / dayLength) % 1. Has no effect if the clock is not in play or if dayLength is invalid.

returns.desc: true if the time was changed.
